description: Which diagnosis --REASON_FOR--> service relations may satisfy medical necessity. A relation authored by the same extraction model that authored the events is not, by itself, independent clinical support: it must be evidence-anchored in the source document, clear the confidence floor, and carry a reconciliation status that the deterministic provenance layer established BY RE-READING THE SOURCE RECORD -- a clause of the note that states the relationship DIRECTIONALLY, naming the verified spans that state it. Bare co-location of the two facts in one passage is recorded but is NOT accepted: it proves both were documented together, never that one is the reason for the other. Neither is AGREEMENT BETWEEN EXTRACTION RUNS: how many distinct assertion origins asserted an edge is recorded on a separate corroboration axis for the audit trail and confidence display, and is never a reconciliation status, because N samples of one model's belief -- same provider or cross-provider -- are still that model's belief and not documentation. Every released service needs such a linkage; where an authoritative coverage policy governs the service the qualifying-diagnosis check is an ADDITIONAL requirement on that same linked diagnosis, in both directions -- never a substitute for the linkage, and never a substitute for grounding it.
authority: Social Security Act 1862(a)(1)(A) -- services must be reasonable and necessary for the diagnosis or treatment of illness or injury
CMS Program Integrity Manual (Pub. 100-08) Chapter 3, Section 3.3.2.1.1 -- the medical record must support the medical necessity of the service billed
CMS Medicare Claims Processing Manual (Pub. 100-04) Chapter 23 -- diagnosis-to-service linkage on the claim
notes: The corroboration THRESHOLD is not declared here: it belongs to the reconciliation layer that reads it (claude_coder/controls/relation_evidence_grammar.json, min_independent_assertions), and since v3 it decides only the audit/confidence corroboration_status, never release. Thresholds and accepted statuses are configuration, not code, so a control change is a reviewed config diff. Nothing here is a medical code, code family, or descriptor proxy: it is a relation-evidence control. Loading is fail-closed -- a missing or malformed control file makes the necessity gate ERROR (autonomy stops) rather than falling back to a built-in default. 'source_colocated' was REMOVED from the accepted set in v2: it records co-occurrence, which is not a directional clinical proposition. 'corroborated' and 'externally_verified' were REMOVED in v3: 'corroborated' was never a statement about the record at all -- it counted agreeing extraction runs, so two runs of the same (or a different) provider agreeing on an inference the note never makes could certify necessity while naming zero source spans; it is now the separate, non-releasing corroboration_status. 'externally_verified' named a verification no layer performs and so could only ever be a forgeable claim. This list is validated on load against provenance.GROUNDED_RECONCILIATION_STATUSES: re-adding an agreement-only or observational value here -- including by restoring an older revision of this file -- makes the gate ERROR rather than releasing claims on it (Codex F6-R3, round 5).
